title: Magical Explorer Reveals Kosuke Takioto Character Trailer Ahead of October Premiere
content: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim anime revealed a a character trailer for the main character, Kosuke Takioto. The anime was previously confirmed to premiere on October 3. Studio WHITE FOX is handling the animation, with Kazuki Ohashi as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary TV Anime Debuts on October 4
content: Rock band FLOW will perform the anime's opening theme song "Unstoppable," while metal band ASTERISM will perform the anime's ending theme song "My Way." Crunchyroll will stream the anime.
author: ANN

title: Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi TV Anime Reveals October 5 Debut, Main Cast in Promo Video
content: Fanworks announced on Friday that Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi — an omnibus short anime adaptation of Yū-hachi 's Dekai Hachi ; Miseban no Spis ; and Ah, Tanuki wa Mō Dame Desu manga — will debut on October 5. The anime will air within Fuji TV 's Nonstop!
author: ANN

title: Romelia War Chronicle Anime Reveals Theme Songs, October 3 Early Streaming Debut in Video
content: The staff of the television anime of Ryō Ariyama 's Romelia War Chronicle: Even After Defeating the Demon King, Humanity Still Seems Doomed, So I Formed a Military Force ( Romelia Senki: Maō o Taoshita Ato mo Jinrui Yabasō Dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita ) light novel series revealed a new promotional video on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 5 Short Anime Perfect For Beginners to Watch in 2026
content: Each year, the anime industry keeps rising in popularity and attracting more fans in the process. Thanks to the dozens of new series released each year, many curious people have been looking to venture into the world of anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Melty Blood:Twi-Lumina 2D Fighter Game's Trailer Reveals April 22 Release, White Len
content: Aniplex of America announced on Friday that it will release Type-Moon 's Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina 2D fighter game on April 22 for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: A Legendary Sci-Fi English Dub Is Finally Streaming After 30 Years
content: The 1990s decade was a revolutionary era in the anime industry that connected Japanese pop culture to the Western audience, paving the path for the medium’s phenomenal success that we witness now. The vibrant world inside these anime was filled with action and adventure, which immediately captured viewers’ attention.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Action Anime Hit Confirms Early Season 3 Release Date With Big Debut Plans
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is less than a month away, and Crunchyroll is already preparing for some exciting surprises for fans. As the largest anime platform for anime fans across the globe, Crunchyroll always releases dozens of anime series each quarter.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Isekai Already Has a Finale Date For Latest Season After Its Biggest Plot Twist
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is less than a month away, and the new lineup is more exciting than ever with the return of Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and some of the most anticipated series with new sequels. The final quarter of the year also has a list of exciting new anime series lineup for this season.

title: Rilakkuma Short Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The new short anime of San-X 's Rilakkuma character ended episode 24 on Saturday with an announcement of the third season, Rilakkuma : Ki Mama ni Manpuku Biyori (Carefree, Well-Fed Days).
author: ANN
